messages:
marta (sales): Heads-up — Saffron Labs is greenlit for a 2-week POC. They want a dedicated GPU pool for inference and evals. Need guidance on SKU/region sizing, VPC access, and pricing. Target start ~Apr 8. cc @kai @ravi

ravi (solutions): Quick q: what throughput/concurrency do they expect? also model family (LlamaX-70B-ish?) and seq lengths?

marta (sales): Good call. They plan to run LlamaX-70B and one smaller 13B reranker. Typical prompt seq ~1024 tokens, evals with longer convs up to 2048. Expected steady QPS ~6 requests/s, peak ~18 req/s for short jobs. Concurrency target ~48 simultaneous sessions during load tests.

kai (infra): For those numbers we should avoid pure A100 unless cost is priority. H100 80GB is ideal for 70B at 1024/2048. EU-west1 H100 capacity is limited this week — we can do a mixed pool: primary H100s + A100s for lower-priority batch/evals.

marta (sales): They asked for 8 H100-equivalent GPUs available, with ability to burst another 4 GPUs for large evals. Preferred EU but can tolerate EU-central as fallback. Need VPC peering + mTLS for control plane, and dev API keys scoped to the pool. Any compliance blockers?

dena (security): mTLS + per-route API keys is fine. We'll need customer CIDR for peering, KMS integration for any keys stored, and audit log forwarding. If they want BYO certs for mTLS, we can support but need cert rotation plan. Also require that Saffron sign the enterprise DPA before provisioning.

ravi (solutions): Confirming: pool size request = baseline 8 H100-equivalent + burst +4 (total 12). Autoscale policy: keep min=6, target=8, max=12? Also do they want preemptible/spot for burst GPUs or strictly reserved?

marta (sales): Prefer reserved for baseline, spot for burst is ok if it doesn't affect SLAs for the POC. They want an estimate for monthly cost vs metered during the 2-week POC.

kai (infra): Proposed config: mixed-sku pool: 6 x nvidia-h100-80gb (reserved commit), 4 x nvidia-a100-40gb (spot-burst), autoscale min=6, target=8, max=12. Region: attempt eu-west1 first; if capacity shortfall, fallback to eu-central1 with cross-region routing. Provisioning ETA: 72-120h depending on quota approvals.

kai (infra): Network/CIDR notes: we'll need a routable customer CIDR for peering (recommend 10.100.0.0/22). We require outbound HTTPS to control-plane IPs and inbound only from our proxies. I can paste the minimal firewall rules after ticket is created.

dena (security): Checklist to include with provisioning request: KMS key ARN, SOC2/ISO attachments (if requested), list of admin users, IP CIDR for peering, certs or BYO cert intent, retention period for audit logs. Also need contact for security review (email).

kai (infra): Ok I'm going to open an internal provisioning ticket with ops. Please reply with billing contact and CIDR so I can attach.

marta (sales): Billing contact: finance@saffron.ai. CIDR provisional: 10.100.8.0/22. They will confirm exact CIDR after legal sign-off.

kai (infra): creating ticket...

deploy-bot: Provisioning ticket PR-4821 created by kai. Details: saffron-poc-mixed-h100-a100, requested region eu-west1 (fallback eu-central1), pool config attached. ETA provisioning window 72-120 hours. Link: https://internal.redwood/provision/PR-4821

marta (sales): perfect — can you include a quick cost ballpark for 2-week POC (reserved baseline vs metered)? I can pass to Saffron so they can budget.

kai (infra): Ballpark: reserved-equivalent commit for 6 H100s ~ $85k/mo (region variance). For a 2-week metered trial (min 6 active, avg burst to 10 for 30% of time) ~ $50-60k for the two weeks. Adding A100 spot bursts reduces cost by ~20% during heavy runs. I'll add precise calc to PR-4821.

dena (security): Also note: if they want private deployment (Private VPC) instead of peering, that adds setup time + extra compliance review. Mention to customer now to avoid surprises.

marta (sales): noted. I'll add to the kickoff. Kai — once PR-4821 has the cost calc and network firewall snippet, I'll schedule the kickoff call with Saffron and copy security. Thanks all :thumbsup:

kai (infra): Will do. Firewall example to attach: ```allow outbound 443 to control-plane.redwood-internal: 35.207.0.0/16, allow inbound from 10.100.8.0/22 to pool-private-ips TCP 22,443; NAT for egress required```

marta (sales): ack, adding to Saffron packet. Scheduling call for Monday.

ravi (solutions): I'll prepare a short perf test plan (throughput & 99p latency checks) to run once pool is up.

marta (sales): awesome — marking thread blocked-on: PR-4821 (kai) and DPA signed (legal).
